capabilities: Suggest lexicon entries while typing, matching Chinese, English, pinyin initials and descriptions
Insert named text templates via a trigger symbol with variables and cursor placement
Auto-number episodes and scenes and renumber a document on command
Insert timestamps at the cursor, into frontmatter, or as new note names
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian ≥ 0.15.0); must be installed manually until it reaches the community store, and it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Ships with no preset lexicons or templates — all content is user-created.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in autocomplete, so writers must retype character names, locations and recurring scene formats from their own reference material every time.
summary: Writing-completion plugin that turns a user-built lexicon into typing suggestions, plus trigger-symbol snippet templates, scene numbering and timestamp tools.
